coinbase_manual.notes: vault_usdc = High Yield Morpho (working float). one_card_security_deposit_usdc = USDC securing the One Card; available credit ≈ deposit − balance owed. Prefer YNAB for live card balance.

robinhood.notes: Primary ••••9737 = equity book + optional margin to fund USDG. Agentic ••••1752 = fund manager equities. USDG Earn (Robinhood Earn / Morpho ~7% est.) is manual: app Crypto→Earn; may roll into portfolio total, not a clean MCP cash field. usdg_earn_usdg = principal currently lent.

ynab.notes: Token at ~/.config/ynab/token. Auto-picks One Card + RH Checking + X Money (Plaid often names X Money as Checking – ####). X Money cash pays ~6% APY (product rate; confirm in app).

pi_sync.notes: P0 2026-08-03: Mac is the live producer (RH MCP, Braiins token, YNAB token). Pi is offline consumer of pushed snapshots — no secrets on Pi. max_age_hours=6; mcp_timeout_s=240; Mac launchd TREASURY_SKIP_PI=1. push_files includes YNAB cash feeds so phone FCC does not show source=empty red. Override: TREASURY_PI_SSH, TREASURY_PI_ROOT, TREASURY_RH_MAX_AGE_HOURS, TREASURY_RH_MCP_TIMEOUT_S, TREASURY_SKIP_PI, TREASURY_SKIP_PUSH_PI=1.
